critique: The delivered core is a uniform finite-transfer and atom-safe coverage theorem for a tightly structured deterministic-profile subclass, not inference over general rare-arm adaptive experiments; the profile contract and early quadratic-variation envelope remain assumed, and the clinical-trial bridge is conditional. The exact diameter frontiers are proved and attained only within selected two-sign late-void experiments; on Li and Zhao's broader class only the converses transfer, with no globally matching confidence procedure. The exhaustive certificate is justified through a net, truncation, and convolution construction but has neither a complexity guarantee nor an end-to-end implementation, leaving practical usability and reproducibility beyond the 16-cell diagnostic unestablished. The framing accurately limits the frontier and sharpness language, but the narrow structured scope, conditional application, and absent scalable implementation constrain the leading-journal score. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
